newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-OTAGO BEAT WAIKATO 34-18 IN SUPER 12.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-OTAGO BEAT WAIKATO 34-18 IN SUPER 12.

text.p: The Otago Highlanders beat the Waikato Chiefs 34-18 (halftime 13-11) in their Super 12 match at Owen Delany Park on Friday.
Otago Highlanders - Tries: Doug Howlett (3). Conversions: Simon Culhane (2). Penalties: Culhane (4), Tony Brown.
Waikato Chiefs - Tries: Caleb Ralph, Glenn Taylor. Penalties: Ian Foster (2). Conversion: Blair Feeney.
